papers.title: Physiology-Aware Masked Cross-Modal Reconstruction for Biosignal Representation Learning (xMAE)
papers.what: Cross-modal masked autoencoder for biosignals that exploits ECG-to-PPG temporal ordering, outperforming baselines on 15/19 health tasks. ICML 2026.
papers.builds_on: Masked Autoencoders Theory (Zhang 2023), Foundation Models for Biosignals (Gu 2025)

papers.title: BenchHAR: Benchmarking Self-Supervised Learning for Generalizable Sensor-based HAR
papers.what: Unified benchmark showing hybrid SSL with CNN encoders generalizes best for HAR; domain-matched pretraining data matters more than raw volume.

papers.title: Can RL Teach Long-Horizon Reasoning to LLMs? Expressiveness Is Key
papers.what: RL training compute scales as a power law with reasoning depth; the exponent increases 2.5x with logical expressiveness, and expressive training transfers better.

papers.title: Beyond Reasoning: RL Unlocks Parametric Knowledge in LLMs
papers.what: RL yields 27% relative gains in factual recall by redistributing probability mass over existing knowledge, not by learning new facts.
